out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. OBSERVED INSTALLATION OF HOBART; MODEL # AM16VLT-ADV; HOT WATER SANITIZING DISHWASHING MACHINE WITHOUT APPROVAL FROM HEALTH DEPARTMENT.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: AMENDMENT INTO PLUS ACCOUNT WITH EQUIPMENT SPECIFICATIONS AND APPLICABLE LAND DEVELOPMENT SERVICE (LDS) PERMITS FOR COMPLETED INSTALLATION FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 50F AND SLICED TOMATOES AT 53F IN KAIRAK 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED SHREDDED MOZZARELLA TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR; SLICED TOMATOES WOULD BE FINISHED IN LESS THAN 30 MINUTES. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND ABLE TO MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: KAIRAK 3 DOOR PREP TOP AT 50-55F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE INITIALLY PLACED SERVICE ORDER. SERVICE TECHNICIAN ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER MOZZARELLA CHEESE TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR. PLEASE DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOODS TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT IS REPAIRED.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system CONNECTED TO MOP SINK FAUCET WITH CHEMICAL DISPENSING SYSTEM ATTACHED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. EMAIL EHS ONCE DEVICE HAS BEEN PURCHASED AND SUBSEQUENTLY INSTALLED.
